title: Subterranean Homesick Blues
tuning: E A D G B E
content:
[Intro]
[A]
John-

[Verse 1]
[A]ny's in the basement,
mixin' up the medicine I'm
on the pavement, thinkin' a-
bout the government The
man in a trench coat,
badge out, laid off
Says he's got a bad cough,
wants to get it paid off
[D7]Look out kid, it's
somethin' you did God
[A]knows when, but you're
doin' it again You better
duck down the alleyway,
looking for a new friend The
[E]man in the coonskin cap
in a pig pen Wants 11
[A]dollar bills-
you only got 10

[Solo 1 (Harmonica)]
[A]
Mag-

[Verse 2]
[A]gie comes fleet foot,
face full of black soot
Talkin' that the heat put
plants in the bed, but
Phone's tapped anyway
Maggie says the many say They
must bust in early May
Orders from the D. A
[D7]Look out kid, don't mat-
ter what you did
[A]Walk on your tip toes,
don't tie no bows
Better stay away from those that
carry around a fire hose
[E]Keep a clean nose,
watch the plainclothes You
[A]don't need a weather man to
know which way the wind blows

[Solo 2 (Harmonica)]
[A]
Oh,

[Verse 3]
[A]get sick, get well,
hang around a ink well
Hang bail, hard to tell if
anything is gonna sell
Try hard, get barred,
get back, ride rail
Get jailed, jump bail,
join the Army if you fail
[D7]Look out kid, you're
gonna get hit By
[A]losers, cheaters, six-
time users Hang-
ing 'round the theaters
[E]Girl by the whirlpool's
looking for a new fool Don't
[A]follow leaders, a-
watch the parking meters

[Solo 3 (Harmonica)]
[A]

[Verse 4]
[A]Oh,
get born, keep warm Short
pants, romance
Learn to dance, get dressed Get
blessed, try to be a
success Please her, please
him, buy gifts
Don't steal, don't lift
20 years of schoolin' and they
put you on the day shift
[D7]Look out kid, they
keep it all hid Better
[A]jump down a manhole,
light yourself a candle
Don't wear sandals, try to
avoid the scandals
[E]Don't want to be a
bum, you better chew gum The
[A]pump don't work 'cause the
vandals took the handles

[Fade-Out]
[A]
